canada.title: Planes grounded across the U.S.: What you need to know if you’re flying from a Toronto airport
canada.summary: A ground stop issued by the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration is impacting flights between Toronto Pearson Airport and the U.S., according to the airport.

canada.title: Endometriosis care in Quebec inadequate, says women's health group in open letter
canada.summary: A women's health advocacy group is calling out Quebec's lack of expertise in endometriosis care and is asking that pain associated with the chronic condition be recognized as a criterion when prioritizing surgeries.

canada.title: Manitoba group seeks millions to bring Indigenous artifacts home
canada.summary: A local organization is in a race against time to purchase a 3,000-piece collection of Indigenous artifacts from a Swiss collector, with a price tag of $14.5 million.

canada.title: Gander International Airport keeping an eye on U.S. flight groundings
canada.summary: A major airport in Newfoundland and Labrador is watching closely as the United States Federal Aviation Administration grounds all flights across the U.S. over an outage affecting air traffic control.

canada.title: APTN Nouvelles nationales – 13 novembre 2026
canada.summary: Ce soir, à APTN Nouvelles nationales, on honore les anciens combattants autochtones. Et Carey Price...

canada.title: Wapiti Regional Library closing 6 rural branches in Sask.
canada.summary: The six library branches slated for closure in December are in Alvena, Gronlid, Mistatim, Pilger, Prairie River and St. Benedict.

canada.title: New Weyburn Humane Society cat room named for highway shooting victim
canada.summary: The new cat playroom at the Weyburn Humane Society is a place for the community to remember Tanya Myers, 44, who was fatally shot while in a moving vehicle on Highway 39, driving toward Weyburn, Sask., in September 2025.

canada.title: PUB analysis finds Manitoba doesn’t need three power turbines recommended by Hydro, Kinew says
canada.summary: Premier Wab Kinew says a Public Utilities Board report shows the province needs to build just one combustion power turbine, not three that Manitoba Hydro has recommended.

canada.title: Montreal police use tear gas to disperse downtown student protest
canada.summary: Montreal police deployed tear gas and moved to disperse crowds Friday afternoon after a student demonstration led to clashes with officers clad in riot gear.

canada.title: Danielle Smith says she’ll call up UCP officials not signing anti-separatism pledge
canada.summary: Danielle Smith said it's not an issue of free speech and she wants the United Conservative Party to work as a team to win next year's provincial election.

canada.title: Trial starts for former air cadet instructor accused of sex offences involving minors
canada.summary: A former flight instructor of air cadets went on trial Friday, accused of exposing his genitals to a minor, supplying an underage person with liquor, and counselling a minor to touch another minor for a sexual purpose while in a position of trust or authority.

canada.title: Boil water advisory lifted for Wekweètì, N.W.T., after water treatment plant issue resolved
canada.summary: The chief public health officer has lifted a boil-water advisory for the community of Wekweètì, N.W.T., four days after it was issued as a precaution.

canada.title: Data centre’s signed deal with Nova Scotia Power ties new system costs to EverWind
canada.summary: Nova Scotia Power and the company that wants to build an $8-billion data centre campus in Point Tupper, N.S., have signed two documents that lay out conditions for connecting the project to the provincial grid.

canada.title: Woman and 2 kids killed in Highway 16 collision, 8-year-old critically injured
canada.summary: A 37-year-old woman and two children died, while an eight-year-old was critically injured in the crash with a semi-truck about 230 kilometres east of Edmonton.

canada.title: 3 dead after boat crash in flooded river near Squamish, B.C.
canada.summary: Three people are confirmed dead after a boat crashed on the Squamish River on Thursday.

canada.title: ‘How does space smell?’ Halifax students connect with Canadian astronaut aboard ISS
canada.summary: High school students in Halifax enjoyed the rare opportunity to chat with Canadian astronaut Joshua Kutryk, direct from the International Space Station.

canada.title: Flights between Canada and U.S. suspended at major airports due to FAA ground stop
canada.summary: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration ordered a ground stop of all American airports on Friday afternoon.

canada.title: Canadian government investing $200M in B.C.’s Woodfibre LNG
canada.summary: The Woodfibre LNG facility, near Squamish, will receive natural gas, cool it into liquefied natural gas, where it will be loaded onto specialized LNG carriers and exported overseas

Flights between Canada and U.S. suspended at major airports due to FAA ground stop, CityNews Winnipeg reports.

Alberta’s government is asking a judge to strike down a First Nation’s constitutional challenge of its sovereignty act, arguing the law hasn’t had any impact on treaty rights, The Canadian Press reports.
A tanker in New Orleans that apparently lost its steering slammed into a docked river cruise boat with 180 people aboard Friday, the mayor said.
Rep. Lauren Boebert of Colorado loses House seat to Democrat Eileen Laubacher, The Canadian Press reports.
US Air Force responds to suspected drone activity at RAF Lakenheath, The Guardian reports.

bds.h: All aboard river cruise boat survive crash with tanker in New Orleans
bds.lede: A tanker in New Orleans that apparently lost its steering slammed into a docked river cruise boat with 180 people aboard Friday, the mayor said. All aboard survived after the crash prompted a massive rescue operation for passengers and crew who plunged into the Mississippi River as the ship took on water and began to topple over.

The incident occurred Friday on the Mississippi River.

bds.h: Rep. Lauren Boebert of Colorado loses House seat to Democrat Eileen Laubacher
bds.lede: Democrat Eileen Laubacher defeated Rep. Lauren Boebert for a Colorado U.S. House seat on Friday, ousting a three-term Republican and staple of conservative media.
rows: ABC News
Colorado Republican Rep. Lauren Boebert will lose her House seat to Democratic challenger Eileen Laubacher, The Associated Press projected Friday.
CBS News
Colorado Democrat Eileen Laubacher has defeated incumbent Republican Congresswoman Lauren Boebert to represent the 4th Congressional District, CBS News projects.
CTV News
Democrat Eileen Laubacher defeated Rep. Lauren Boebert for a Colorado U.S. House seat on Friday, ousting a three-term Republican and staple of conservative media.
Fox News
Rep. Lauren Boebert, R-Colo., lost her congressional seat to Democratic challenger Eileen Laubacher. Boebert, an ally of President Trump, was seeking a fourth term.
NBC News
The Colorado Republican moved to a more conservative district after a close re-election call in 2022. But this year’s blue tsunami has swept her out of office, NBC News projects.
